steps.journalDescription: I've been told to take my midday break, then to find Chief Tabor to receive my next assignment. I can find Chief Tabor in front of Weft's hut: the largest hut in the western most part of the camp.

On account of my conduct during the hostage crisis, Chief Tabor said I have been summoned to the Director's office. I should enter the Manse in the west section of the camp, then proceed to the second floor. The Director's office will be the last door on the right.

The Director has offered me a deal: seal the pocket on the bottom floor of the mine, and I will earn my freedom. If I intend to accept his deal, I must return to his office on the second floor of the Manse.

I accepted the Directors offer. I must now seal the pocket on the bottom floor of the mine, and I will earn my freedom. I must first learn how to use the blasting jelly required to collapse the tunnel the worms are coming out of. I need to walk down to the mine entrance in the camp's southwest and enter the stockhouse there. Quartermaster Emese will be able to teach me how to use the blasting jelly.

I have been taught how to use blasting jelly. I now need to procure some. Quartermaster Emese said I'll need to make for the stockroom on the third floor of the mine. That's where the blasting jelly is kept.
